core_skills.name: Quantum Algorithm Design
core_skills.description: Generate a correct, runnable quantum algorithm (Bell/GHZ/QFT/Grover/DJ/PE) with a verified one-time pass contract.

core_skills.name: Circuit Transpilation & Resource Estimation
core_skills.description: Compile to a target basis set; report CNOT count, depth, and shot budget.

core_skills.name: Simulation & Statevector Check
core_skills.description: Run on a simulator (default.qubit / Aer / cirq.Simulator) with pinned seeds; produce reproducible samples.

core_skills.name: Measurement Calibration & Error Mitigation
core_skills.description: Apply measurement-error mitigation, ZNE, or Pauli twirling; report corrected observables.

core_skills.name: Analytic Reference Validation
core_skills.description: Compare measured/statevector results against analytic references; emit PASS/FAIL with tolerance.

core_skills.name: Reproducibility & Traceability Check
core_skills.description: Verify pinned seeds/versions and a complete, replyable state log for the experiment run.

core_skills.name: Experiment Report Generation
core_skills.description: Produce a reproducible report with config, raw data, analysis, and PASS/FAIL verdict per stage.

core_skills.name: Ion-Trap Hardware Binding
core_skills.description: Bind the experiment to an ion-trap device from the model hardware standard (quantum/hardware): device profile, native gate family (gpi/gpi2/zz|ms, phasedx/zzphase, r/rxx), all-to-all coupling, credential state, and execution-tier plan (simulation/emulator/qpu).

core_skills.name: Ion-Trap Hardware Execution
core_skills.description: Execute the circuit on the bound ion-trap device through the hardware standard's honest tier ladder: vendor-compiler emulator offline by default (Quantinuum pecos H2-1E, IonQ native-gate sampling, AQT offline sim); real QPU submission only with explicit allow_qpu=true AND credentials. Every job is appended to the jobs.jsonl ledger with a counts hash.

coverage_note: Each core skill is an invocable, composable, verifiable unit. Skill count >= 5 required at completion.
